CustomObject.label: AgenticTelco Fulfilment Setting
CustomObject.description: Build-time choices for AgenticTelco fulfilment, read when the plan is set up (AgenticTelco_OrchestrationSetup), never switched at run time. Assetisation route: CUSTOM_STEP (an AgenticTelco step in the Salesforce plan writes the installed product) or BUILT_IN (the platform's own asset step). One route only, no fallback.
